dct_title_s: Proposed location and arrangement of the asphalt plant and storage yard at Dean Boulevard, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A proposed location and arrangement of the asphalt plant and storage yard at Dean Boulevard in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirty-third Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 110.
